focus_areas: Texture realism of the large organic pendants (checking for AI 'muddy' textures).
Physical connectivity of the beaded strands (checking for fused or floating beads).
Consistency of metallic reflections across different components.
Objective verification of clasp and chain/link presence via detection.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the metal settings and the gemstones. In AI images, these often blur together. Also, inspect the 'facets' on the green beads; real glass has sharp, straight edges, while AI often generates warped or irregular facets. Use the detector outputs to isolate these regions for detailed boundary analysis.
image_description: A close-up studio shot of an ornate, vintage-style statement necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a bib design with multiple irregular, organic-shaped pendants (resembling leaves or abstract stones) in earthy tones of green, brown, and amber, set in tarnished silver metal. These pendants are adorned with small inset gemstones (red, blue, purple). The upper portion consists of beaded strands featuring faceted green and purple beads leading to a clasp area.
